description: This Java source file defines the SimpleEventHandler class within the org.apache.ofbiz.webapp.event package. The class handles simple events in the OFBiz web application framework by executing specified mini-language methods, managing transactions, and handling errors.

classes.name: SimpleEventHandler
classes.description: A handler for processing simple mini-language events within the OFBiz web framework, managing transactions and error reporting.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the event handler with the servlet context. Currently, this implementation does nothing.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes a specified event by executing its associated simple mini-language method, managing transaction scope, and handling errors. Returns the outcome of the event or 'error' if execution fails.
